title: Fix silent failures in pack CLI utility functions
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**File**: `cmd/cordumctl/pack.go`

Three utility functions silently swallow errors:

1. **recordsToAny (lines 1170-1177)**: Both json.Marshal and json.Unmarshal errors return empty map — caller can't tell success from failure.

2. **deepCopy (lines 1471-1484)**: On Marshal/Unmarshal failure, returns the original value instead of a copy. Caller thinks it has an independent copy but actually shares a reference, leading to unintended mutations.

3. **appendCanonicalMap (line 1533)**: `json.Marshal(k)` error ignored. Empty keyBytes written to buffer silently.

Also: **chat.go:167** — JSON unmarshal error creates silent fallback system message instead of logging.

**Fix**: Log errors in these functions and/or return them. For deepCopy, return `(any, error)` so callers know when copy failed.
definitionOfDone: recordsToAny returns or logs errors on marshal failure
deepCopy returns error or logs warning when falling back to original

implementationPlan.description:
**deepCopy** (pack.go:1471-1484): Add `slog.Warn` when falling back to original value. Changing the signature to return `(any, error)` would break all callers; logging is the minimal fix:
```go
if err != nil {
    slog.Warn("deepCopy: marshal failed, returning original", "error", err)
    return value
}
```

**chat.go:167**: Add `slog.Warn` when unmarshal fails and content is treated as system message:
```go
if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &ev); err != nil {
    slog.Warn("chat: corrupt history event, treating as system", "index", i, "error", err)
    ...
}
```
Run `go test ./cmd/cordumctl/... ./core/controlplane/gateway/...` to verify no regressions.
